steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.desc: We start with a conversation about your brand, audience, and goals. You bring the brief — we bring the questions that sharpen it into a direction.

steps.title: Concept & Script
steps.desc: We develop the core idea, write the script, and lock a shot list. You approve everything before a camera is picked up.

steps.title: Shoot
steps.desc: We handle the full production — location, talent, gear. Varghese leads cinematography on every project personally.

steps.title: Edit & Deliver
steps.desc: Cut, colour, sound, and captions — a polished file ready for broadcast, social, or wherever your audience lives.
